messages.subject: AMOVA output p values
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I'm using poppr.amova() function to study structure in human mitochondrial genotypes from a population sample. I have performed the test as I copied after this message. My question is, why am I receiving only one p value as an output? It should not output a within population variance p value and one between Region_verificada variance p value? I have only one population subdivision, which is between regions. I am assuming that the p value I got is between regions, but what should I do to get the within population p value?
Thanks in advance!

> amova <- poppr.amova(popsub(mt_gn1, sublist = c("CW","S","SE"), blacklist = NULL, mat = NULL, drop = TRUE)

messages.subject: Re: AMOVA output p values
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

In your AMOVA call, you only specify region within the hierarchy (Region_verificada). You are only getting a single p-value (and a single value of Phi) because the there is only one hierarchical level to test against.
If you want to include your defined population, you need to 1) make sure it's included in your strata and 2) specify it in your hierarchy formula.

If you did not define your population in your strata, you can add it like this:

addStrata(myData) <- data.frame(population = pop(myData))

and then you can add /population to the end of your hierarchy in poppr.amova()

I hope that helps. We have some documentation on the function here: https://grunwaldlab.github.io/poppr/reference/poppr.amova.html. Don't hesitate to ask any followup questions if you need clarification.

All the best,
Zhian
